topic: A Mix-Up at the Drive-Thru Window

script.title: A DRIVE-THRU MIX-UP
script.story_hook: A wrong drink turns into a drive-thru rescue.
script.intro_zh: 一杯錯飲品，展開一場得來速救援。
script.welcome_en: Hey everyone! Today we're fixing an order at the drive-thru.
script.welcome_zh: 大家好！今天要處理得來速拿錯餐的狀況。
script.outro: Wrong tray again? Now you can handle it in English.
script.outro_zh: 再拿到錯餐？現在你能用英文搞定它了！
script.practice_intro_en: Let's review together. Repeat after me.
script.practice_intro_zh: 一起來複習，跟著我重複。
script.char_a_description: an easygoing man in his mid thirties with short sandy hair and light stubble, wearing a heather gray quarter-zip fleece, glancing back toward his car seats
script.char_b_description: a chipper young woman around nineteen with perky twin ponytails dyed teal, wearing a golden-yellow drive-thru visor and matching polo, stacking receipt rolls by the window
script.youtube_title: 【🚗🥤得來速救場英文】「兩分鐘就好」怎麼說？拿錯餐飲料、請店員重做全靠這 18 句｜🎧Drive-Thru English
script.youtube_title_en: "Two Minutes, Tops" — A Mix-Up at the Drive-Thru Window
script.youtube_description:
在得來速拿到錯的餐點，搖下車窗該怎麼開口？這集 18 句車道對話教你：指出錯誤、問等待時間、把車往前開、收下補償折價券。全部用最常聽到的美式口語，附繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽完馬上會用。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱我們的頻道，每天一集，讓英語變成你的直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
Grabbed the wrong tray at the drive-thru window? This 18-line scene shows you how to flag the mistake, ask how long a remake takes, pull forward when told, and accept a goodwill coupon. All in the most common American spoken English, with IPA transcription and a repeat-after-me section.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🚗得來速英文｜指出錯餐・把車前移・收下折價券｜聽完就會換餐｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
得來速窗口搖下來，才發現飲品尺寸不對？
趕時間又不想吵架，該怎麼清楚又禮貌地說？

這一集帶大家走進傍晚忙碌的速食店車道，跟著一位爸爸從指出錯餐、確認重做時間、把車往前開，到收好折價券道別，全程都是自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
🥤 指出錯誤：例如「something's off with my order.」、「I asked for a large iced tea.」
⏱️ 確認等待：例如「Will that take long?」、「Could you pull forward?」
🎟️ 收尾與補償：例如「No hassle at all.」、「Here's a coupon for the mix-up.」

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下次得來速遇到錯餐，搖下窗口就能從容解決！

script.thumbnail_action: holding a small cup beside a large order bag

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, something's off with my order here.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ˈsʌmθɪŋz ɔf wɪð maɪ ˈɔrdər hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我的餐點好像有點不對。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh? What did you get, versus what you ordered?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ wʌt dɪd ju ɡɛt ˈvɜrsəz wʌt ju ˈɔrdərd/
dialogue.zh: 噢？您拿到的是什麼，點的又是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I asked for a large iced tea, this is small.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈæskt fɔr ə lɑrdʒ aɪst ti ðɪs ɪz smɔl/
dialogue.zh: 我要的是大杯冰茶，這杯是小杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ugh, sorry about that. Anything else wrong?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌɡ ˈsɑri əˈbaʊt ðæt ˈɛniθɪŋ ɛls rɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 呃，好抱歉。還有別的地方不對嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, the fries are salted... mine are no salt.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ðə fraɪz ɑr ˈsɔltɪd maɪn ɑr noʊ sɔlt/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，薯條加了鹽……我要的是無鹽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it. Let me fix both right now, okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt lɛt mi fɪks boʊθ raɪt naʊ oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 了解，我馬上幫您重做這兩樣，好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will that take long? I'm kind of in a rush.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ðæt teɪk lɔŋ aɪm kaɪnd əv ɪn ə rʌʃ/
dialogue.zh: 會很久嗎？我有點趕時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two minutes, tops. Could you pull forward?
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈmɪnɪts tɑps kʊd ju pʊl ˈfɔrwərd/
dialogue.zh: 最多兩分鐘。麻煩您把車往前開好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure, that little gray spot up ahead works?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr ðæt ˈlɪtəl ɡreɪ spɑt ʌp əˈhɛd wɜrks/
dialogue.zh: 好，前面那個灰色車位就可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, right there. Keep your window down, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs raɪt ðɛr kip jʊr ˈwɪndoʊ daʊn pliz/
dialogue.zh: 對就那裡。請把車窗搖下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, waiting here. Hope it's not a hassle.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ˈweɪtɪŋ hɪr hoʊp ɪts nɑt ə ˈhæsl/
dialogue.zh: 好的，我在這等。希望不會造成麻煩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No hassle at all, happens to us too sometimes.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈhæsl æt ɔl ˈhæpnəz tə ʌs tu ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz/
dialogue.zh: 一點都不會，我們偶爾也會出錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, you're too kind, honestly. No rush though.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ jʊr tu kaɪnd ˈɑnəstli noʊ rʌʃ ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 你人真好，說實話。不過我現在也不趕了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here's your tray: large tea, no-salt fries.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪrz jʊr treɪ lɑrdʒ ti noʊ sɔlt fraɪz/
dialogue.zh: 這是您的餐盤：大杯茶、無鹽薯條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect timing, thank you! My kid will be glad.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpərfɪkt ˈtaɪmɪŋ θæŋk ju maɪ kɪd wɪl bi ɡlæd/
dialogue.zh: 時間剛剛好，謝謝！我小孩會很開心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And here's a coupon for the mix-up today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd hɪrz ə ˈkupɑn fɔr ðə ˈmɪks ʌp təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 這張折價券補償今天的錯誤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? That's awesome, see you next week!
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɪli ðæts ˈɔsəm si ju nɛkst wik/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Drive safe! Thanks for your patience today.
dialogue.phonetic: /draɪ seɪf θæŋks fɔr jʊr ˈpeɪʃəns təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 開車慢走！謝謝您今天的耐心。
